gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-009 identifies the same Figure 1a parameter configuration, checks the theorem's required condition gamma_{j,epsilon} >= delta_{j,epsilon}, and shows that the listed gamma values are below the fixed delta=1 on every branch. It therefore directly diagnoses the false claim that the experiment satisfies the convergence theorem.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The Figure 1a parameter set is asserted to satisfy the convergence theorem even though its displayed gamma values violate the theorem's required per-segment inequalities gamma_{j,epsilon} >= delta_{j,epsilon}.

component_coverage.gold_component: The claimed theorem compliance of Figure 1a is false because delta_{j,epsilon}=1 while every listed gamma_{j,epsilon} is less than 1, so the required condition fails on every segment.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction reproduces the relevant parameter comparison, identifies failure of the exact theorem hypothesis on every branch, and states the resulting false theorem-based status of the plotted experiment, including the option of withdrawing or replacing the parameter set.
